description: names_match (lines 528-554) correctly implements RFC 5280 §4.1.2.4: RDN sequence ordering is positional (RDN[0] vs RDN[0]), but within each RDN (a SET OF AVA), comparison is order-independent. Uses .any() to find matching AVA across the set (O(n²) acceptable for typical 3-7 AVAs). Line-count comment (lines 528-531) explains the RFC distinction clearly for future maintainers. The length checks (lines 543-545) prevent set subset attacks (e.g., CN=Alice matching CN=Alice,OU=Ops).
title: Decision: RDN set semantics correctly implemented
